name: Bárbara Colen
bio: Bárbara Colen (Belo Horizonte, February 17, 1986) is a Brazilian actress.

credits.title: Fogaréu
credits.overview: On the border between the real and the fantastic, between the colonial past and the overwhelming modernity of agribusiness, the city of Goiás is the scene of the meeting between the young Fernanda and her secret roots. credits.title: On Behalf of My Son
credits.overview: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. credits.title: Reteté
credits.overview: The 1990s. A radiant, indomitable girl is medicated until she becomes the well-behaved child the church demands. To reclaim the daughter she once knew, her mother must confront her congregation, her family, and even God.

credits.title: The French Teacher
credits.overview: Graça, a lesbian woman living in Belo Horizonte with her French girlfriend Clara, gives private French lessons to support herself in a large Brazilian metropolis. credits.title: Cinco Tipos de Medo
credits.overview: Murilo, a grieving musician, falls for Marlene, a nurse trapped in an abusive relationship with criminal Sapinho. Their fates intertwine with Luciana, a vengeful cop, and Ivan, a lawyer with hidden motives, as five lives collide on an irreversible path.

credits.title: Braza
credits.overview: In a small town in the Brazilian countryside, 16-year-old Analu lives with her mother and helps care for two-year-old Dani. Burdened with responsibilities beyond her age, she secretly dates a delivery driver and begins planning her escape with him, while holding onto a secret that grows harder to hide.

credits.title: Oysters Silence
credits.overview: The film tells the story of a woman who lives in a village of mining workers.

credits.title: The Girl Who Killed Her Parents: The Confession
credits.overview: See what Suzane von Richthofen, Daniel Cravinhos and Cristian Cravinhos did in the days following the brutal crime that led to the Richthofen couple's death. This film reveals crucial moments of the police investigation, testimonies and the confession of the crime.

credits.title: Our Mother was an Actress
credits.overview: Maria José Novais Oliveira, a black woman, resident on the outskirts of Contagem, already in her 60s, has become a film actress, with an award-winning career in Brazil and internationally. This documentary recalls the image of a unique woman who marked Brazilian cinema in the 2010s.

credits.title: Abandonment
credits.overview: The couple Laura and Israël have a five-year-old son, Lucas. They live together but seem to have lost interest in one another's thoughts and cares. Their relationship seems headed for the rocks, and the only one who seems to still be looking for something from life is Lucas.

credits.title: A Memória Sitiada da Noite
credits.overview: In the endless night, only two bodies remain. What story is left after the end?

credits.title: Burning Night
credits.overview: Down on his luck and recently divorced, Paulo has begun driving a cab around Rio, hoping he’ll make enough to send his ex money to support their ten-year-old son. credits.title: Bacurau no Mapa
credits.overview: Behind the scenes of Bacurau (2019)'s shooting and pre-production. With exclusive images, directors Kléber Mendonça Filho and Juliano Dornelles show how they made the film an audience and critical success.

credits.title: Bacurau
credits.overview: Bacurau, a small town in the Brazilian sertão, mourns the loss of its matriarch, Carmelita, who lived to be 94. Days later, its inhabitants notice that their community has vanished from most maps.

credits.title: In the Heart of the World
credits.overview: The inhabitants of the Brazilian city of Contagem yearn for a better life. At the core of it all is Selma, a woman dreaming about the heart of the world: it could be anywhere, as long as it's a place where to feel happier.

credits.title: Dia de Reis
credits.overview: The work is inspired by Shakespeare's play "Twelfth Night", and the whole narrative is built around the festivities of the Folia de Reis and an unexpected love born of this tradition.

credits.title: Outer Edge
credits.overview: Fragments of an endless night, Robert and Teresa meet and get to know each other, and get separate by the force of oppression and the threat of death and disappearance that continually creeps in.

credits.title: Aquarius
credits.overview: Clara, a vibrant former music critic and widow with flowing tresses is the only remaining apartment owner in a beautiful older building targeted for demolition by ruthless luxury high-rise developers. Clara proves to be a force to be reckoned with as she thwarts the builders plans to kick her out of the apartment.

credits.title: Contagem
credits.overview: An event, four people and the city of Contagem.
